name: strategic-explainer
description: Turn source-grounded technical results into concise, human-readable explanations without losing meaning, uncertainty, or next actions.

interface.shortDescription: Explain technical results clearly without losing the point.
interface.longDescription: Strategic Explainer is a standalone read-only semantic facade for one real user-facing comment, report, decision explanation, blocker report, final, or explicit editing request. A client supplies only the purpose, bounded scope, language and material constraints, plus resolvable read-only source anchors. The facade owns its internal execution, isolation, profile selection, validation, and retry behavior; none of that invocation recipe or the provider's editing method is part of the client contract. It returns publication-ready text with a separate source basis or reports operational unavailability. It does not choose scope or status, make authority decisions, mutate systems, orchestrate the caller's work, or bundle connectors.
defaultPrompt: Подготовь понятный итог по этой задаче для указанного читателя по приложенным источникам
Подготовь этот target text к публикации, сохранив его material facts и указанные constraints
Подготовь понятное объяснение этой блокировки для пользователя по указанным source anchors
